description: Small held-out English phrasing check on the same original five-page corpus; not an independent-document benchmark.
pages: A password reset link is delivered to the registered email address. Reset links expire after fifteen minutes.
Subscriptions can be cancelled from billing settings. Access continues until the paid month ends.
Orders ship within two business days. Delivery tracking appears by email.
Uploaded files are deleted thirty days after account closure.
Mira earned a Bachelor of Science at Cedar University.
